reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the sachets and the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code. I travel a lot and count capsules into a pill case, so a sachet a day that I can throw in my bag saves me that step. I'd only try the bisglycinate, because the citrate in the complex is what gives me stomach cramps.
objection: It's a new brand with zero reviews and $29.99 is more than my usual bottle costs per serving. I'm paying extra for the packaging and the lab report, and I can't yet tell whether the QR report is real or just decoration.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews, or a batch report I can open and see that it's a real lab with the magnesium amount matching the box. A price closer to $24 would also make me switch from my usual bottle sooner.
